hypothesis: Public pending station inputs permit a useful provisional index before canonical publication; compare that lead with market reaction before claiming an edge
stage: Exploratory source arithmetic and actual-receipt latency audit, not a strategy test
registration_trigger: Observed live incomplete index points already containing five pending station temperatures; no provisional error or return scores inspected
input_gate: All five exact primary members; no fallback, backfill or future receipts; pending/ok codes only; finite temperatures in published hard range
calibration_gate: Version effective at event minute and published before actual decision receipt; use archived calibration available by that receipt
formula: Weighted Celsius temperature minus station offset plus full-roster city reference; convert to Fahrenheit only at final output
quality_control: Pending values have not completed source QC; the provisional result must never become a settlement label
rounding: Report half-up and half-even nearest-cent alternatives; methodology does not specify ties explicitly
historical_arithmetic_audit: All 24512 previously acquired E004 canonical points, conditional on published source QC flags
live_audit: Every captured incomplete minute with all five primary readings; retain first eligible receipt, compare with first observed later canonical publication
independence: Minute counts are operational observations within one day, not independent weather events
returns: No P&L, fills, probability calibration or capital recommendation inferred; real-money size stays zero
